description: WZ N-jets scale factors (K-factors for WZ) measured in WZ combined control regions. Per-run, per-jet-bin. Last bin (Nj+) is the merged overflow. Uncertainties stored as fractions (e.g. 0.10 = 10%), all bin-by-bin: stat (CR measurement), nonprompt (per-era FakeNorm.json), prompt (quadrature sum of theory norms for subtracted backgrounds), total (quadrature sum of all three).
